title: AI Security Startup Corma Closes $125 Million Series A Funding: Valuation Reaches $1 Billion in 3 Months
excerpt: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma recently announced the completion of a $125 million Series A funding round, led by NEA, with the company’s valuation rapidly soar
content_html: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma recently announced the completion of a $125 million Series A funding round, led by NEA, with the company’s valuation rapidly soaring to $1 billion within just three months of launching its product. To date, the company has raised a total of $185 million, with early investors including Sequoia Capital, Khosla Ventures, and Coatue. As a frontier AI research lab focused on security protection, Corma mainly provides AI models and agents for cybersecurity defense.
